Results.ReviewText: This grill stopped working after minimal use. I called customer service who advised me it was under warranty and needed a valve/regulator   This was sent to me.  There were six pages of instructions about how to replace this part, very complicated and requiring considerable disassembly of the grill. Six different tools were required for this job.  I have only one of the required six tools. I called back to customer service and was told there really wasn’t anything they could do. The woman hung up on me because it was “ the end of [her] shift and the supervisor was walking out the door.”  Don’t expect much from this grill or customer service.

I also purchased the attachment enabling me to hook it up to a regular size tank (I didn't like the idea of disposable gas containers) and the removable cover..  Instructions were clear and I had no problems whatsoever adding the hose.  Did I mention--I LOVE all the colors it comes in.  IF you are looking for a grill for a small family OR want a portable grill that doesn't weight a ton--this is what you want.

Also Webber included a 'cheat sheet' for cooking meats and vegetables--time amounts and recommended temperatures which helped me a lot since it's been awhile since I grilled anything.

Results.ReviewText: Purchased about a month ago. First thing I noticed (but it was not noted on the box) was that there is , out of the box (OTB), no way to connect a 20 pound tank. A hose is easily gotten from the store, but it should have been included with the grill. It will handle the small 1-2 pound tanks OTB.  The pictures of the grill on its stand show it on the portable stand (additional purchase). What is not shown is the other stand. This second stand has a convenient place for the larger tank. Nothing is said about that stand on the grill's packaging. Finally, my previous Weber grill included a cookbook with grilling guides for temps and cook times. These are, sort of, availabe through Weber online. This could be stated prominently on the apaerwork included with the grill. For customers, we get a place to find the tips we need. For Weber, it would encourage people to visit the Weber website more regularly (which I would otherwise not do). I still really like this grill. Easy to set up. Easy to use. Takes up minimal space on my patio.

It cooks food quickly with such a great taste so even though it doesn’t hold a whole lot you can still have 6-7 good size steaks cooked in less than 30 minutes (ours will hold 3-4 ribeyes and cooks to perfection in about 10-12 minutes). Super happy with this purchase!
Results.Title: Awesome Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill just right for two full time RV people!!

Results.ReviewText:
I have grilled and roasted numerous times on my new Q1200, and overall I am quite pleased. There were a couple flaws I have encountered. With the great Weber support, I am working through them. 

I am having the original regulator replaced, for the temperature ran too hot while on LOW setting while roasting. On low, it ran between 390 and 410 degrees, instead of  what Weber stated should be 325 to 350.  I have yet to install the replacement on my next day off. Hopefully this will resolve the  temperature issue.

When attempting to install the recommended portable 16.4 oz propane cylinder, it does not line up, due to the grill  structure being in the way, not allowing the 90 degree angle needed to thread onto the regulator. When I contacted Weber, they said it was a known design flaw, and I would have to place slight pressure on the regulator housing in order to align the portable propane tank, allowing it to thread properly. 

The optional roasting pan is no longer available, so I created my own that works just as well if not better.

Although not necessarily a flaw, but one needs to watch for grease drippings from the lid, when opened. This happens when grilling 80% lean burgers, or any meat with fat. I have my Q1200 on the collapsible, portable Webber stand, and the grease will drip on the cross members of the stand and to the wooden deck, or whatever surface. I now periodically wipe the back edge of the lid (where the grease accumulates) while grilling burgers. Afterwards, I wipe the inside of the lid.

The grill surface is great. I always coat with peanut or grape seed oil prior to preheating. Nothing sticks when grilling in accordance with recommended grill times before turning/flipping. It also makes clean up much easier. I also seasoned the optional griddle. This now permits me to cook pancakes, french toast and even eggs without sticking at all. I did find out when placing the griddle on the grill surface, the griddle has even heat distribution, no hot spots. Unlike when you remove on half of the grill, as recommended, replacing with the griddle, there is a circular hot spot.

I am quite please with the Q1200 and have recommended to those who have inquired.
Results.Title: Great product. Everything I had expected.

Results.ReviewText:
It has been a long time since I had a gas grill. I've been looking at this grill for the last 3 years and after Weber Day at Plymouth Nursery I finally caved in. My first three cooking choices were a pork roast, hamburgers and ribs. All three turned out really good. 
So far I'm satisfied with this little gem and very glad I purchased the model with the thermometer. My only suggestion would be a very low burner temp setting for slower cooking because the lowest setting is still quite hot.
Results.Title: Good choice for small cooking

Results.ReviewText: I got this grill for my birthday in June and I Love it.  It is the perfect size and cooks food evenly...
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Had the Baby Q for 13 years and just replaced it with the Q 1200 because it was time for a new grill.loved the Baby and am loving the 1200. Excellent quality.  Cooks food perfectly.  Great size for rolling in and out of a garage because we live in a townhouse and aren’t allowed to leave it out. can fit a lot of food on it at one time and cooks everything evenly.
